# AGI Jobs — Your next idea starts here

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs/current-release.mjs. Edit its template, then run npm run docs:gen. -->

[![Your next idea starts here. A website, a presentation or a clear report. Une idée suffit pour commencer.](site/assets/start-here.svg)](https://montrealai.github.io/AGIJobManager/employers/)

**Latest reported mainnet deployment:** [17 October Manager and authority record](docs/deployments/MAINNET_MANAGER_2026-10-17.md). Manager `0x3a9B3A0712e066de4265404Fa5ff4171fE29a3F8`; intake paused, identity configuration unlocked. Earlier instances and their claims remain separate.

**Latest retained ENS configuration:** [19 October snapshot and fee/source-review limitations](docs/deployments/ENS_CONFIGURATION_RETAINED_2026-10-19.md). Helper `0xBaC826CF5f169EA168A23173F3DbBdA7Ed953400`, root `usdc.jobs.agi.eth`, prefix `job-v2-`; historical block `26,227,598` at `2026-10-19T15:44:23Z`. This is not a current-state or activation claim.

## What would you like done?

A simple website. A presentation. A clear report. Begin with your idea and prepare a request for AI workers, one step at a time. You do not need to install software or understand the code in this repository.

### [Start my request →](https://montrealai.github.io/AGIJobManager/employers/) · [Commencer ma demande →](https://montrealai.github.io/AGIJobManager/fr/employers/)

**Free to prepare · No sign-up · No wallet needed to start**

1. **Choose an example.** Pick the result closest to your idea, or describe something else.
2. **Make it yours.** Say what you need, choose a proposed budget and decide how to check the work.
3. **Keep your request.** Download it, print it, or save it in this browser and come back later.

Use **Larger text** if that makes reading more comfortable. The guided page has everyday words, large buttons and editable examples in English and French. Nothing is posted or paid for while you prepare your request.

**En français :** [Commencez ici](https://montrealai.github.io/AGIJobManager/fr/employers/). Choisissez un exemple, décrivez votre idée, puis enregistrez ou imprimez votre demande. La préparation est gratuite, sans inscription. Le bouton **Texte agrandi** facilite la lecture.

**When you are ready to publish:** a separate, advanced screen handles posting and payment. It currently requires a digital wallet, USDC for the job and ETH for Ethereum fees; there is no card checkout. Verify the operator and availability before funding. Preparing a request does not reserve a worker or guarantee a result. [Read the full employer guide](docs/ui/EMPLOYER_ONBOARDING.md).

[Explore the AGI Jobs website](https://montrealai.github.io/AGIJobManager/) · [Site en français](https://montrealai.github.io/AGIJobManager/fr/) · [Participant and operator guides](docs/START_HERE.md) · [Current USDC console](https://montrealai.github.io/AGIJobManager/agijobmanager-usdc.html)

## SUCCESSOR Ω Builder for everyone

Create a small working system, inspect its files, try a measured improvement, choose the version you want and download a copy you can restore. The free local path runs in your browser without an account, installation, wallet or provider key.

**[Open the Builder](https://montrealai.github.io/AGIJobManager/successor/)** · **[Ouvrir le Créateur](https://montrealai.github.io/AGIJobManager/fr/successor/)** · [Guide and reproducible walkthrough](docs/successor/README.md).

Two bounded local engines produce real editable artifacts: a public-data report with exact decimal totals, and a static website with semantic structure and optional section navigation. They use reviewed deterministic code. Custom missions can be specified and exported; their execution remains unavailable until a suitable runtime is commissioned. Local checks, independent qualification, payment and permission remain separate.

**En français :** créez un rapport de données publiques ou un site simple, vérifiez le résultat, choisissez une amélioration et téléchargez votre système. Le parcours local fonctionne sans compte, portefeuille ni clé de fournisseur. [Guide français](docs/successor/GUIDE_FR.md).

## Inspect a transformation campaign

The retained v1.19.5 developer adapter inspects a complete Alpha transformation campaign with an installed, compatible native inspector and independently supplied runtime bindings. The current native pilot has zero currency allowances: **inspection is free; a positive paid proposal is unsupported**. Inspection does not execute work, grant permissions or sign a transaction. The existing local Builder and its pinned runtime remain unchanged. Start with the [{{TAG}} guide](docs/releases/{{TAG}}/START_HERE.md) and [adapter contract and recovery](docs/successor/TRANSFORMATIONAL_WORK.md). This is a developer API, not a new console action.

## Historical October 10 instance — ENS connected, activation on HOLD

The 10 October 2026 [deployment and connection record](docs/deployments/MAINNET_USDC_2026-10-10.md) reports the verified helper at `0x6EE7A600C56C1Bfd12c482190d5dAbDD7194CDBC` connected to manager `0xCFA78f9980eA9B55c705B3E44467baE383cE1fA7`, using **`job-<jobId>.usdc.jobs.agi.eth`**. At the recorded block **26,165,026**, intake was paused and no job had been posted. This is dated operator evidence, not a live status indicator or permission to fund jobs.

**Production activation remains on HOLD.** The [activation review and five closeout gates](docs/OPERATIONS/PRODUCTION_ACTIVATION.md) are separate from successful deployment. The proposed 100-USDC commissioning ceiling is a draft, not an applied setting. Default console/deployment addresses remain blank; no automatic connection, approval, funding or unpause is introduced.

## Ideas behind the work

[Read four selected essays](https://montrealai.github.io/AGIJobManager/#reading) on choosing workers, public work history and delivery evidence. Each article links to its current guide. [Reading notes and version context](docs/READING.md) · Articles en anglais, résumés français disponibles.

## For developers, operators and release reviewers

AGIJobManager is the software behind the USDC job contract and supporting tools. The technical documentation, qualification evidence and deployment instructions follow below. [Website publishing guide](docs/ui/GITHUB_PAGES.md).

**Current software version: {{TAG}} — Scoped dependency maintenance candidate.**

AGI Jobs covers work a person or team can do using a keyboard, mouse and screen. Employers define the result and acceptance criteria; AGI Agents perform the work; AGI Nodes independently validate the delivered result. AGIJobManager provides the on-chain job lifecycle, USDC escrow, bonded voting, dispute outcomes and payment recovery. Computer execution and judging the work happen outside the contract.

**New automated work uses operator budgets without retainers.** Agent/Node admission requires schema 6; employer funding requires schema 7; both require `reviewPayment: operator-budget`. Existing retainer credits, refunds and journals remain recoverable. Use [no-retainer operations](docs/OPERATIONS/NO_RETAINERS.md) and the [current admission reference](docs/OPERATIONS/QUALIFIED_ADMISSION.md). The manual console and permissionless contract do not enforce these private admission policies.

## Learn from measured outcomes

This edition tightens [operating qualification](docs/OPERATIONS/OPERATING_QUALIFICATION.md): each held-out job class must meet loss-rate and supervision limits as well as separate Agent/Node cash floors. The [project economics planner](docs/OPERATIONS/PROJECT_ECONOMICS.md) accounts for unpaid intermediate stages, failed work, deposits and each participant's capital. Examples at $100, $1,000 and $10,000 are explicitly assumptions. Use the [bounded pilot guide](docs/OPERATIONS/VALUE_TIER_PILOT.md) to replace those assumptions with real-machine evidence. Private companions also reject stale desktop observations after a failed refresh.

The [Astra review pilot](docs/OPERATIONS/ASTRA_REVIEW_PILOT.md) shows why reviewer participation can fail a job that otherwise passes modeled work checks. Its offline scheduler reserves three independent reviewer windows across competing jobs; its pilot audit keeps completion, supervision, Agent/Node losses, settlement defects and judgment errors separate. The study is synthetic, and neither tool authorizes live intake.

## One job, from specification to payment

1. The employer defines the deliverables and independently checkable acceptance criteria, then posts the agreed USDC amount.
2. An eligible Agent checks the job, obtains any required bond allowance and takes the assignment.
3. The Agent completes the work and submits its delivery URI before the applicable deadline.
4. Eligible independent Nodes inspect the actual result and vote within the review period. Missing or uncertain evidence must not become invented approval.
5. The appropriate caller settles, disputes, expires or refunds the job under its actual state and deadlines. Failed outgoing transfers remain reserved for the original beneficiary to claim.

Read [buyer protection](docs/BUYER_PROTECTION.md), the [participant guide](docs/USERS.md) and [protocol flow](docs/PROTOCOL_FLOW.md) for all outcomes. The private project coordinator schedules separately admitted Agent/Node stages and binds independently accepted inputs. It does not implement atomic project settlement; see [confidential project work](docs/OPERATIONS/CONFIDENTIAL_PROJECT_WORK.md).

## Payments and identity

Successful jobs pay the validator allocation first (**8% default**), then **30% of the original job cost to wallet one**, **10% to wallet two**, and the remainder to the Agent. When the full default reviewer allocation is paid, a 100 USDC job pays 8 / 30 / 10 / 52. Buyer acceptance with zero validators instead pays 0 / 30 / 10 / 60, excluding separate bond returns; the reviewer budget is shared, not paid once per reviewer. The validator percentage is fixed when each job is posted. Bonds, slashing and refunds are separate; [the payout specification](docs/USDC_PAYOUT_SPLIT.md) defines rounding and all branches.

Agents normally use `*.agent.agi.eth` or `*.alpha.agent.agi.eth`; Nodes use `*.club.agi.eth` or `*.alpha.club.agi.eth`. Configured allowlist/Merkle exceptions also exist. **NFT eligibility is disabled by default** on fresh managers and is separate from role membership. Read [identity and proofs](docs/guides/IDENTITY_AND_PROOFS.md) and [NFT policy](docs/NFT_POLICY.md).

The generic fresh-deployment script uses `job-<jobId>.usdc-<chainId>-<manager40>.alpha.jobs.agi.eth`; this is a tooling policy, not a required contract suffix. The separately commissioned instance uses `job-<jobId>.usdc.jobs.agi.eth`. Existing managers preserve their recorded namespace and labels. [ENS naming policy](docs/ENS_DEPLOYMENT_NAMESPACES.md) describes ownership and wiring.

## What the contract cannot establish

| Question | Evidence still needed |
| --- | --- |
| Does the work meet the buyer's needs? | Measurable acceptance criteria, accessible deliverables and independent inspection |
| Are different participants actually independent? | Conflict disclosures and operating controls beyond wallet and credential comparisons |
| Is participation economically worthwhile? | Actual work, review, gas and capital costs across successful, disputed and unpaid outcomes |
| Can a newcomer use the complete journey? | Observed user sessions; automated browser tests do not substitute for them |
| Is this particular instance ready for paid jobs? | Verified signers, recipients, policy, participants, monitoring and an actual readiness report |
| Has the release received external assurance? | A separately obtained independent security and economic review; internal reviews do not provide this |

Owner pauses can delay exits; USDC issuer restrictions can delay transfers; unavailable arbitration can leave honest work unpaid after neutral refund. Final settlement has no built-in chargeback, revision round or partial settlement. Read [buyer protection](BUYER_PROTECTION.md) and [economics](game-theory.md) before committing funds.

## Put the release into use

Start with [the participant guide](START_HERE.md), run the [observed acceptance journeys](V1_ACCEPTANCE.md), and keep the actual instance's [launch checklist](LAUNCH_CHECKLIST.md) with its evidence. The release validation record describes what was executed for the source; it must not be copied as proof of a live instance.

The qualification approach follows layered testing, access-control review and operational precautions described in [Ethereum's smart-contract security guidance](https://ethereum.org/developers/docs/smart-contracts/security/). Native USDC addresses must be checked against [Circle's current registry](https://developers.circle.com/stablecoins/usdc-contract-addresses).

## Current admission primitives

The public tools cover explicit lifecycle stress cases, operator-owned economic limits, signed evidence attestations, and current canonical two-RPC terms. They do not implement an autonomous signing service or certify market inputs. See [qualified admission](OPERATIONS/QUALIFIED_ADMISSION.md) and [current pre-funding and closure scope](OPERATIONS/PREFUNDING.md).

def validate_run(api, logs, workflow, item, source, *, publication=False):
    require(workflow in WORKFLOWS and item['workflow'] == workflow, 'Unknown workflow identity')
    require(type(item['id']) is int and item['id'] > 0 and type(item['attempt']) is int and item['attempt'] > 0, 'Invalid run identity')
    run = api(f'actions/runs/{item["id"]}')

    if workflow == 'pages.yml':

        wanted = ['Verify qualified source checkout', *REQUIRED_STEPS[workflow]]
        if workflow == 'ci.yml' and job['name'] == 'build (0)':
            wanted += ['Released USDC console browser checks', 'Simulation accounting regression checks', 'UI smoke test']
        for name in wanted:
            steps = [s for s in job.get('steps', []) if s['name'] == name]
            require(len(steps) == 1 and steps[0]['status'] == 'completed' and steps[0]['conclusion'] == 'success', 'Required step did not execute successfully: ' + name)

        require(marker == [source], 'Missing, duplicate or wrong checkout log evidence')

def validate_qualification(config, api, logs, *, publication=False):
    require(config.get('repository') == REPOSITORY and config.get('tag') == TAG and config.get('name') == TITLE, 'Release identity differs')
    require(config.get('status') == 'qualified' and valid_sha(config.get('sourceCommit')) and valid_sha(config.get('sourceTree')), 'Release is not qualified')

def verify_assets(out, config=None):
    out = pathlib.Path(out)
    expected = {}
    for line in (out / 'SHA256SUMS.txt').read_text().splitlines():
        digest, name = line.split('  ', 1)

    require(set(expected) == names and {p.name for p in out.iterdir()} == names | {'SHA256SUMS.txt'}, 'Unexpected or missing assets')

    if config is not None:

        require(config['artifactDigests'] == {n: d for n, d in expected.items() if n != 'QUALIFICATION.json'}, 'Qualification asset binding differs')
    expected['SHA256SUMS.txt'] = sha((out / 'SHA256SUMS.txt').read_bytes())
    return expected

"""Safely extract the exact package, verify complete inventory, and run offline smoke checks."""
import argparse
import json
import pathlib
import runpy
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zipfile
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
from release_common import TAG, TITLE, REPOSITORY, WORKFLOWS, LIMIT, require, sha, valid_sha, verify_assets, source_path, verify_builder_rebuild, verify_builder_context_outputs, strict_json
from release_common import builder_reconstruction, retained_builder_package

candidate_policy = runpy.run_path(str(pathlib.Path(__file__).with_name('package-policy.py')))

def package_inventory(assets, *, published=False, profile='legacy-v114', manifest=None,
                      manifest_sha256=None, verifier_sha256=None, schema_sha256=None):
    """Verify local bytes and recorded bindings, without claiming live CI/provenance verification."""
    selection = candidate_policy['select'](profile, manifest=manifest, manifest_sha256=manifest_sha256,
        verifier_sha256=verifier_sha256, schema_sha256=schema_sha256, published=published)
    config = None
    if published:
        qualification = assets / 'QUALIFICATION.json'
        require(qualification.is_file() and not qualification.is_symlink() and qualification.stat().st_size < 1_000_000, 'Published qualification is missing or oversized')
        config = json.loads(qualification.read_text())
        require(config.get('repository') == REPOSITORY and config.get('tag') == TAG and config.get('name') == TITLE and config.get('status') == 'qualified', 'Published qualification identity differs')
        require(valid_sha(config.get('sourceCommit')) and valid_sha(config.get('sourceTree')) and config.get('checkoutCommit') == config['sourceCommit'], 'Published source binding differs')
        require(set(config.get('requiredSourceRuns', {})) == set(WORKFLOWS), f'Published qualification must record all {len(WORKFLOWS)} workflows')
    if published and selection and selection.get('releaseProfile') in ('manager-transformational-v1', 'manager-dependency-maintenance-v1'):
        runpy.run_path(str(pathlib.Path(__file__).with_name('transformational-qualification.py')))['verify_record'](config)
    if published and selection and selection.get('releaseProfile') == 'manager-dependency-maintenance-v1':
        runpy.run_path(str(pathlib.Path(__file__).with_name('maintenance-qualification.py')))['verify_record'](config)
    verify_assets(assets, config)
    manifest_bytes = (assets / 'RELEASE_MANIFEST.json').read_bytes()
    manifest = strict_json(manifest_bytes)
    require(valid_sha(manifest.get('sourceCommit')) and valid_sha(manifest.get('sourceTree')), 'Invalid manifest source identity')
    candidate_policy['validate_metadata'](manifest, selection)
    return manifest, manifest_bytes

def archive_inventory(archive, manifest):
    """Bound every entry and the total expansion before decompressing any entry."""
    prefix = f'AGIJobManager-{TAG}/'
    require(isinstance(manifest.get('files'), dict) and len(manifest['files']) < 20_000, 'Invalid or oversized source inventory')
    expected = set(manifest['files']) | {'RELEASE_MANIFEST.json'}
    require(len(archive.infolist()) == len(expected) and {i.filename for i in archive.infolist()} == {prefix + n for n in expected}, 'Archive inventory is incomplete or contains extras/duplicates')
    require(sum(item.file_size for item in archive.infolist()) < LIMIT, 'Archive expanded size exceeds the package limit')
    for item in archive.infolist():
        require(item.filename.startswith(prefix), 'Archive prefix differs')
        name = item.filename[len(prefix):]
        path = pathlib.PurePosixPath(name)
        require(path.as_posix() == name and not path.is_absolute() and '..' not in path.parts and '\\' not in name, 'Unsafe archive path')
        require(not name.startswith('source/hardhat/contracts/'), 'Archive entries must not traverse the retained contracts symlink')
        mode = item.external_attr >> 16
        require((stat.S_ISREG(mode) or (name == 'source/hardhat/contracts' and stat.S_ISLNK(mode))) and item.file_size < LIMIT, 'Unsupported archive entry')
        if name.startswith('source/'):
            source_path(name[len('source/'):], mode)
    return prefix

def verify_package(assets, *, published=False, profile='legacy-v114', manifest=None,
                   manifest_sha256=None, verifier_sha256=None, schema_sha256=None):
    assets = pathlib.Path(assets)
    options = dict(profile=profile, manifest=manifest, manifest_sha256=manifest_sha256,
        verifier_sha256=verifier_sha256, schema_sha256=schema_sha256)
    selection = candidate_policy['select'](**options, published=published)
    manifest, manifest_bytes = package_inventory(assets, published=published, **options)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='agijobmanager-package-smoke-') as temp, zipfile.ZipFile(assets / f'AGIJobManager-{TAG}-COMPLETE.zip') as archive:
        prefix = archive_inventory(archive, manifest)
        for item in archive.infolist():
            name = item.filename[len(prefix):]
            mode = item.external_attr >> 16
            data = archive.read(item)  # Reading checks the CRC after the bounded inventory review.
            if name == 'RELEASE_MANIFEST.json':
                require(data == manifest_bytes, 'Embedded manifest differs')
            else:
                details = manifest['files'][name]
                require(len(data) == details['bytes'] and sha(data) == details['sha256'] and mode == details['mode'], 'Payload identity differs: ' + name)

                require(name == 'source/hardhat/contracts' and data == b'../contracts', 'Unsafe symlink target')
                require((target.parent / data.decode()).resolve() == pathlib.Path(temp) / 'source/contracts', 'Symlink escapes source')

            else:
                target.write_bytes(data)
                target.chmod(mode & 0o777)
        require((pathlib.Path(temp) / 'agijobmanager-usdc.html').read_bytes() == (assets / 'agijobmanager-usdc.html').read_bytes(), 'Standalone console differs')
        source_dir = pathlib.Path(temp) / 'source'
        if selection is not None:
            candidate_policy['validate_source'](source_dir, selection)
        regenerated = pathlib.Path(temp) / 'rebuilt'
        selected_package = retained_builder_package(temp)
        with builder_reconstruction(source_dir, manifest.get('builderSource'), selected_package):
            verify_builder_context_outputs(manifest['builderSource'], temp)
            subprocess.run(['node', 'scripts/successor/build.mjs', '--out', str(regenerated)], cwd=source_dir, check=True)
            verify_builder_rebuild(regenerated, assets, temp)
            subprocess.run(['node', '--test', 'scripts/successor/portable.test.mjs'], cwd=source_dir, check=True)
        subprocess.run(['node', 'scripts/release/verify-usdc-ui.mjs', '.'], cwd=source_dir, check=True)
        subprocess.run(['python3', 'scripts/release/test-release-gates.py'], cwd=source_dir, check=True)
        if selection is not None and selection.get('releaseProfile') in ('manager-transformational-v1', 'manager-dependency-maintenance-v1'):
            subprocess.run(['node', '--test', 'scripts/integrations/transformational-work-request.test.mjs', 'scripts/integrations/transformational-native-source.test.mjs'], cwd=source_dir, check=True)
            subprocess.run(['python3', 'scripts/release/test-transformational-qualification.py'], cwd=source_dir, check=True)
            subprocess.run(['python3', 'scripts/release/test-publication-authorization-ti.py'], cwd=source_dir, check=True)
    print('Verified complete inventory and clean-extraction offline smoke checks. No wallet, credentials or network required.')
    if selection is not None and 'releaseProfile' not in selection:
        print('Candidate source package only: input identity is bound; release identity is unselected and release qualification is false.')
    if published:
        print('Published qualification bindings match. Live CI status, release authenticity and attestations must be verified separately.')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('assets', type=pathlib.Path)
    parser.add_argument('--published', action='store_true', help='Require the complete published inventory, including QUALIFICATION.json and its exact asset/source bindings')
    candidate_policy['add_selection_arguments'](parser)
    verify_package(**vars(parser.parse_args()))

"""Bounded read-only wait; final collector still validates every required job and artifact."""
import argparse
import json
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import time
from release_common import REPOSITORY, WORKFLOWS, require, valid_sha


def readiness(api, source):
    require(valid_sha(source), 'A complete source commit is required')
    if api('git/ref/heads/main')['object']['sha'] != source: return 'superseded'
    pending = False
    for workflow in WORKFLOWS:
        identity = api(f'actions/workflows/{workflow}')
        require(identity['path'] == '.github/workflows/' + workflow, 'Qualification workflow identity differs')
        runs = api(f'actions/workflows/{identity["id"]}/runs?head_sha={source}&event=push&per_page=100')['workflow_runs']
        matching = sorted((run for run in runs if run.get('head_sha') == source and run.get('head_branch') == 'main' and run.get('event') == 'push'), key=lambda run: run['id'], reverse=True)
        if not matching: pending = True; continue
        run = matching[0]
        require(run.get('workflow_id') == identity['id'] and run.get('repository', {}).get('full_name') == REPOSITORY and run.get('head_repository', {}).get('full_name') == REPOSITORY, 'Qualification run repository or workflow differs')
        if run.get('status') != 'completed': pending = True; continue
        require(run.get('conclusion') == 'success', 'A required exact-source workflow failed, was cancelled or was skipped')
    return 'pending' if pending else 'ready'


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--source', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--timeout-seconds', type=int, default=2700)
    parser.add_argument('--poll-seconds', type=int, default=30)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(1 <= args.timeout_seconds <= 2700 and 5 <= args.poll_seconds <= 60, 'Qualification wait must remain bounded')
    require(os.environ.get('GITHUB_REPOSITORY') == REPOSITORY, 'Qualification wait repository differs')
    def api(endpoint):
        result = subprocess.run(['gh', 'api', f'repos/{REPOSITORY}/{endpoint}', '--method', 'GET'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
        require(result.returncode == 0, 'Qualification metadata request failed (response withheld)')
        return json.loads(result.stdout)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + args.timeout_seconds
    while True:
        status = readiness(api, args.source)
        if status != 'pending': break
        require(time.monotonic() + args.poll_seconds <= deadline, 'Exact-source qualification did not finish within the bounded wait')
        print('Waiting for all eight required exact-source workflows.', flush=True)
        time.sleep(args.poll_seconds)
    with pathlib.Path(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT']).open('a') as output:
        output.write('ready=' + ('true' if status == 'ready' else 'false') + '\n')
    print('Qualification readiness: ' + status + '. Final job, step, source, artifact and attestation validation remain mandatory.')


if __name__ == '__main__': main()

# AGIJobManager UI — v1.19.6

Use the [current release notes](../docs/releases/v1.19.6/RELEASE_NOTES.md), matching [repository artifact](agijobmanager-usdc.html), and [operator guide](../docs/ui/GENESIS_JOB_MAINNET_HTML_UI.md). The [previous v1.19.4 release](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGIJobManager/releases/tag/v1.19.4) retains its original source and evidence; it does not qualify this wrapper. Verified v0.9.6 and v1.13.0 managers share the required ABI and deployed runtime bytecode; v1.13.0 construction initializes NFT admission as disabled. Existing manager settings and job snapshots are unchanged. This console retains the v0.9.6 saved-context namespace, rechecking wallet, chain and manager before writes. v0.9.5 and older managers lack getJobBonds; keep their jobs on their original interfaces. See [compatibility](../docs/qualification/OPERATIONS_V097.md). No live manager, recipient wallets or production owner is supplied by default.

The retained [v1.19.5 transformation adapter](../docs/successor/TRANSFORMATIONAL_WORK.md) is a developer inspection API, not a new console or Builder action. The current native pilot has zero currency allowances; inspection cannot produce a positive paid proposal, execute work or authorize a transaction. The Builder’s immutable v1.19.4 code pin is preserved.

All current job payments and bonds use native Circle USDC with six decimals. Verified v0.9.6 managers remain compatible. Moving from the original-token manager requires a fresh USDC deployment; the original manager keeps its own jobs and ENS wiring. Follow the [USDC migration guide](../docs/USDC_MIGRATION.md) and [Hardhat deployment guide](../hardhat/README.md).

## Choose a surface

| Surface | Purpose | Configuration and status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [USDC standalone console](agijobmanager-usdc.html) | Versioned single-file participant and owner interface | Ethereum mainnet; voting requires the `getJobBonds` getter introduced in v0.9.6; no embedded live-manager default or token bridge |
| [Operator interface](../docs/ui/agijobmanager.html) | Additional USDC role and owner workflows | Configure the intended manager and network |
| Next.js app in this directory | Broader UI, development, simulation and demo workflows | Environment-driven; manager address starts empty |
| `dist-ipfs/agijobmanager.html` | Generated single-file distribution | Built and verified from the UI source; configuration remains deployment-required |
| [Historical console sources](https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGIJobManager/tree/v0.4.0/ui) | Reproduce earlier interfaces | Legacy evidence; do not use as current USDC deployment configuration |

The Pages filename `agijobmanagerv0.html` is a historical compatibility alias. The repository workflow copies the current standalone source there, so it can change with `main`; its name is neither a release version nor evidence of a live deployment. Use an immutable release download and matching checksums for reproducible operations. See [Pages publishing](../docs/ui/GITHUB_PAGES.md).

## Before participant actions

AGI Agents normally require membership under `agent.agi.eth` or `alpha.agent.agi.eth`; AGI Validators under `club.agi.eth` or `alpha.club.agi.eth`. Use only the label, and verify the connected wallet's supported NameWrapper authority or resolver address. The manager preserves owner-managed additional lists and Merkle proofs as explicit membership exceptions. Agents also require an eligible enabled NFT when the job's posting-time NFT requirement is on (the default). Optional ENS job pages are separate metadata and do not grant either participant role.

Verify the chain, manager, canonical USDC, both recipients and current role/job state before signing. Review exact USDC allowance and bond requirements and retain ETH for gas. UI checks complement source/runtime verification; a wallet prompt or simulation does not guarantee inclusion or success.

## Use the standalone console

Open `agijobmanager-usdc.html` directly, or from the repository root serve this directory locally:

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory ui
```

Open `http://127.0.0.1:8000/agijobmanager-usdc.html`. Browser wallets and network resources are still needed for live operations. Enter no seed phrase or private key into the page. Read [the console guide](../docs/ui/GENESIS_JOB_MAINNET_HTML_UI.md) for transaction/recovery behavior.

## Develop the Next.js UI

From the repository root, use Node 22.23.2 and the committed lockfile:

```bash
cd ui
npm ci
if [ ! -e .env.local ] && [ ! -L .env.local ]; then cp .env.example .env.local; fi
NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_ACTOR=visitor npm run dev
```

The guarded copy preserves an existing environment. Demo mode uses synthetic data and does not establish production readiness. For live configuration, review the selected chain and verified manager/owner/deployment block; examples do not supply an official new USDC deployment.

The [UI documentation hub](../docs/ui/README.md) covers architecture and development. From `ui/`, the supported qualification commands include:

```bash
npm run check:no-binaries
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run test:e2e
npm run test:a11y
npm run test:headers
npm run build:ipfs
npm run verify:ipfs
npm run verify:deterministic
npm run verify:committed-html
```

Use the repository's required CI gates and exact release evidence to assess a source revision. The current explicit-governor route sets the final owner atomically during creation; verify that governor and zero pending owner in the creation readback. Only a later, explicitly proposed ownership transfer requires the proposed owner's acceptance. Creation, authority readback, ENS root authority and live-instance activation remain in the [operator runbooks](../docs/DEPLOYMENT/README.md); publishing an interface performs none of those transactions.

  <div class="container">
    <div class="mastheadBadge">ASI Access · Jobs.AGI.eth</div>
    <h1>AGIJobManager · Genesis Mainnet Console</h1>
    <div class="subtitle">Sovereign coordination infrastructure for frontier intelligence work. Operate jobs, verification, USDC payments, identity flows, and protocol settlement with institutional-grade precision.</div>
    <div id="sessionRestoreNote" class="statusline" style="display:none;margin:0 0 16px"></div>

    <div class="card" id="accessWalletCard">
      <div class="row">
        <div class="statusline" style="flex:1;min-width:260px">
          <div><b>Wallet</b>: <span id="walletStatus">Not connected</span></div>
          <div class="muted" style="margin-top:4px">Network: <span id="chainStatus">—</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="actions">
          <button class="btn btn-primary" id="connectBtn">Connect Wallet</button>
          <button class="btn" id="refreshBtn" disabled>Refresh</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div id="toast" class="statusline" style="margin-top:12px;display:none"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="heroNotice">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="noticeTitle">Before You Transact</div>
        <div class="banner">
          This protocol is experimental. Jobs, bonds, validator outcomes, disputes, NFT minting, and settlement all depend on the deployed smart contract rules. Token transfers can be irreversible.
        </div>
        <div class="helper" style="margin-top:12px">
          Read the protocol notices below and verify the selected deployment's operator, fees and service terms before signing. MONTREAL.AI publishes MIT-licensed software; each deployment's actual operator and owner powers matter.
        </div>
        <div class="checkline">
          <input type="checkbox" id="termsAccepted">
          <label for="termsAccepted" style="margin:0">I have read the v1.0.5 protocol notices and risks below. I understand that the selected deployment may have separate operator terms.</label>
        </div>
        <div class="actions" style="margin-top:12px">
          <button class="btn smallBtn" id="jumpToTermsBtn">Read Terms</button>
          <button class="btn smallBtn" id="expandTermsBtn">Expand All Terms</button>
          <button class="btn smallBtn" id="collapseTermsBtn">Collapse All Terms</button>
          <a href="https://github.com/MontrealAI/AGIJobManager/tree/v1.0.5/docs/LEGAL" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Legal notices and privacy</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="card">
        <div class="noticeTitle">Quick Bond Calculator</div>
        <div class="helper" style="margin-bottom:10px">Fast planning tool using the live contract parameters shown on this page. Validator bond uses the public bond parameters directly. Dispute bond follows the contract constants in the verified source. Agent bond uses deterministic client-side math that mirrors the verified BondMath parameters (payout, duration, bps, min, max, and duration limit).</div>
        <div class="calc-grid">
          <div class="miniStat" style="grid-column:1/-1">
            <label for="calcPayout">Job payout ($USDC)</label>
            <input id="calcPayout" type="number" min="0" step="0.0001" placeholder="e.g. 88888" style="width:100%">
          </div>
          <div class="miniStat" style="grid-column:1/-1">
            <label for="calcDuration">Job duration (seconds)</label>
            <input id="calcDuration" type="number" min="1" step="1" placeholder="e.g. 604800" style="width:100%">
          </div>
          <div class="miniStat"><span class="k">Agent bond (BondMath mirror)</span><span class="v" id="calcAgentBond">—</span></div>
          <div class="miniStat"><span class="k">Validator bond</span><span class="v" id="calcValidatorBond">—</span></div>
          <div class="miniStat"><span class="k">Dispute bond</span><span class="v" id="calcDisputeBond">—</span></div>
          <div class="miniStat"><span class="k">Validator reward pool</span><span class="v" id="calcRewardPool">—</span></div>
        </div>
        <details style="margin-top:10px">
          <summary>Calculation trace audit</summary>
          <div class="helper" id="calcTraceAudit">Enter payout/duration to inspect raw-unit clamp and premium steps.</div>
        </details>
      </div>
    </div>


    <div class="eliteHero" id="missionControlSection">
      <div class="card elitePanel">
        <div class="row" style="align-items:flex-start;gap:16px">
          <div style="flex:1;min-width:280px">
            <div class="eyebrow">Mission Control</div>
            <label for="missionRole">What would you like to do?</label>
            <select id="missionRole" aria-describedby="missionRoleHelp">
              <option value="employer">Buy work — employer</option>
              <option value="agent">Do work — agent</option>
              <option value="validator">Review work — validator</option>
            </select>
            <div class="smallNote" id="missionRoleHelp">Choose a guide. Your wallet and the contract determine which actions you can take.</div>
            <div class="missionTitle" id="missionNextActionTitle">Connect wallet</div>
            <div class="helper" id="missionNextActionBody">Connect your Ethereum mainnet wallet to unlock live protocol state, role verification, job posting, validation, and settlement flows.</div>
            <div class="missionPill" id="missionPosturePill">Write access locked</div>
            <div class="heroActions">
              <button class="btn btn-primary" id="missionPrimaryBtn">Connect wallet</button>
              <button class="btn" id="missionSecondaryBtn">Open create job</button>
              <button class="btn" id="openCommandPaletteBtn">Command Palette</button>
              <button class="btn" id="missionBuyerProtectionBtn">How is my payment protected?</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div style="flex:1;min-width:260px">
            <div class="heroStatusGrid">
              <div class="heroStatusCard"><span class="k">Wallet</span><span class="v" id="missionWalletStatus">Not connected</span></div>
              <div class="heroStatusCard"><span class="k">Network</span><span class="v" id="missionNetworkStatus">—</span></div>
              <div class="heroStatusCard"><span class="k">Terms</span><span class="v" id="missionTermsStatus">Pending</span></div>
              <div class="heroStatusCard"><span class="k">Agent ENS</span><span class="v" id="missionAgentStatus">Unverified</span></div>
              <div class="heroStatusCard"><span class="k">Validator ENS</span><span class="v" id="missionValidatorStatus">Unverified</span></div>
              <div class="heroStatusCard"><span class="k">Write access</span><span class="v" id="missionWriteStatus">Locked</span></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="card elitePanel">
        <div class="eyebrow">Live Snapshot</div>
        <div class="missionTitle">Protocol Pulse</div>
        <div class="helper">A cleaner high-level view of the live job board, your watchlist, and where attention is currently needed.</div>
        <div class="heroStatusGrid">
          <div class="heroStatusCard"><span class="k">Open jobs</span><span class="v" id="pulseOpenCount">0</span></div>
          <div class="heroStatusCard"><span class="k">Assigned</span><span class="v" id="pulseAssignedCount">0</span></div>
          <div class="heroStatusCard"><span class="k">In review</span><span class="v" id="pulseReviewCount">0</span></div>
          <div class="heroStatusCard"><span class="k">Disputed</span><span class="v" id="pulseDisputedCount">0</span></div>
          <div class="heroStatusCard"><span class="k">Terminal</span><span class="v" id="pulseTerminalCount">0</span></div>
          <div class="heroStatusCard"><span class="k">Watchlist</span><span class="v" id="pulseWatchlistCount">0</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="snapshotHint" id="pulseVisibleSummary">No jobs loaded yet.</div>
      </div>
    </div>


    <div class="card">
      <div class="row" style="align-items:flex-start">
        <div style="flex:1;min-width:280px">
          <h2 style="margin:0 0 8px">Command Center</h2>
          <div class="helper">This interface is optimized for three roles: <b>Employer</b>, <b>Agent</b>, and <b>Validator</b>. Use the guided sections below to understand what is live, what you can do right now, what your likely next action is, and what economic exposure you are taking before signing.</div>
          <div class="anchorNav">
            <a href="#workflowSection">Workflow</a>
            <a href="#readinessSection">Readiness</a>
            <a href="#insightsSection">Economics</a>
            <a href="#jobsSection">Jobs Table</a>
            <a href="#termsSection">Terms</a>
          </div>
          <div class="smallNote" style="margin-top:10px">v1.19.6 · Compatible with verified v0.9.6/v0.9.7 and v1.0.x/v1.1.0/v1.2.x managers. USDC jobs: validators first, then 30% to wallet one, 10% to wallet two, and the remaining balance to the agent.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="callout warn" style="max-width:380px">
          <b>Operational note</b><br>
          Posting, applying, approving, disputing, expiring, and finalizing are all separate on-chain actions. This UI helps you decide, but the deployed contract decides the outcome.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="card" id="readinessSection">
      <h2 style="margin:0 0 12px">Action Readiness</h2>
      <div class="kpiGrid">
        <div class="kpi"><span class="label">Wallet</span><span class="value" id="readyWallet">Not connected</span></div>
        <div class="kpi"><span class="label">Network</span><span class="value" id="readyNetwork">—</span></div>
        <div class="kpi"><span class="label">Terms</span><span class="value" id="readyTerms">Not acknowledged</span></div>
        <div class="kpi"><span class="label">Role readiness</span><span class="value" id="readyRole">View mode</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="split" style="margin-top:12px">
        <div class="accordion">
          <details open>
            <summary>What to do first</summary>
            <div class="body">
              <ul class="softList">
                <li>Connect the wallet you want to use on Ethereum Mainnet.</li>
                <li>Buyers can post without ENS membership. Agents and validators use their role credential or owner-approved allowlist/Merkle authorization; this console guides the ENS path.</li>
                <li>Read and acknowledge the protocol notices here, then verify the manager address and USDC settlement settings.</li>
                <li>Use the bond calculator and the economics charts before signing.</li>
              </ul>
            </div>
          </details>
          <details>
            <summary>Best-practice transaction flow</summary>
            <div class="body">
              <ul class="softList">

          <summary><b>What if the agent does not deliver, or the work is poor?</b></summary>
          <ul class="smallNote">
            <li><b>No agent assigned:</b> cancel and recover your full escrow.</li>
            <li><b>No submission by the deadline:</b> expire the job to recover escrow and the agent’s forfeited bond.</li>
            <li><b>A submission contains poor, missing or inaccessible work:</b> open an on-chain dispute before the displayed cutoff. A link alone does not prove delivery. The quoted dispute bond and gas are additional upfront costs.</li>
            <li><b>Buyer wins:</b> full escrow returns without the 30%/10% fees; your dispute bond also returns. Gas, lost time and outside costs are not reimbursed by this rule.</li>

    async function getActiveJobIdsFromEvents(totalHint){
      const now = Date.now();
      if(activeJobIndexCache.ids && (now - activeJobIndexCache.ts) < 20_000){
        return activeJobIndexCache.ids.slice();
      }
      try{
        const [createdEvents, cancelledEvents] = await Promise.all([
          agiJobManager.getPastEvents('JobCreated', {fromBlock:0, toBlock:'latest'}),
          agiJobManager.getPastEvents('JobCancelled', {fromBlock:0, toBlock:'latest'})
        ]);
        const created = new Set();
        for(const ev of createdEvents || []){
          const id = Number(ev?.returnValues?.jobId);
          if(Number.isInteger(id) && id >= 0) created.add(id);
        }
        for(const ev of cancelledEvents || []){
          const id = Number(ev?.returnValues?.jobId);
          if(Number.isInteger(id) && id >= 0) created.delete(id);
        }
        const ids = Array.from(created).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
        const missingCreatedEvents = !createdEvents || !createdEvents.length;
        const degraded = !ids.length && Number(totalHint || 0) > 0 && missingCreatedEvents;
        if(degraded){
          APP_STATE.jobsReadDegraded = true;
          activeJobIndexCache.ids = [];
          activeJobIndexCache.ts = now;
          setToast('Job index event scan missing JobCreated coverage; no synthetic IDs will be shown.', 'warn');
          return [];
        }
        APP_STATE.jobsReadDegraded = false;
        activeJobIndexCache.ids = ids.slice();
        activeJobIndexCache.ts = now;
        return ids;
      }catch(error){
        if(!isExpectedRpcRevert(error)) console.error('[getActiveJobIdsFromEvents]', error);
        APP_STATE.jobsReadDegraded = true;
        if(activeJobIndexCache.ids && activeJobIndexCache.ids.length) return activeJobIndexCache.ids.slice();
        setToast('Job event indexing unavailable; no synthetic IDs are shown in degraded mode.', 'warn');
        return [];
      }
    }

      const controls = [...modal.querySelectorAll('button:not([disabled]), a[href], input:not([disabled]), [tabindex="0"]')];

      const first = controls[0], last = controls[controls.length - 1];

    async function runTrackedTx(label, methodFactory, options={}){
      if(trackedTransactionPending) throw new Error('A transaction is already in progress. Wait for its receipt before sending another.');
      const context = options.writeContext || activeReviewedContext || captureWriteContext();
      trackedTransactionPending = true;
      let pending;
      try{
        await assertLiveWriteContext(context);
        await verifyUSDCDeployment();
        await assertLiveWriteContext(context);
        const method = methodFactory();
        const transaction = {from:context.account, value:'0'};
        await method.call(transaction);
        await assertLiveWriteContext(context);
        pending = addTxActivity({ label, state:'pending', detail: options.pendingDetail || 'Waiting for wallet confirmation…' });
        const promi = method.send(transaction);
        if(promi && typeof promi.on === 'function'){
          promi.on('transactionHash', hash=>{
            updateTxActivity(pending.id, { txHash: hash, detail: options.submittedDetail || 'Submitted to Ethereum mainnet. Waiting for confirmation…' });
          });
        }
        const receipt = await promi;
        if(!receiptSucceeded(receipt)) throw new Error('Transaction reverted or its success could not be confirmed. Check the transaction in your wallet before retrying.');
        if(options.invalidateJobIndex !== false){
          activeJobIndexCache.ids = null;
          activeJobIndexCache.ts = 0;
        }
        updateTxActivity(pending.id, { state:'success', txHash: receipt?.transactionHash || pending.txHash || '', detail: options.successDetail || 'Confirmed on-chain.' });
        return receipt;
      }catch(err){
        if(pending) updateTxActivity(pending.id, { state:'error', detail: err?.message || String(err) });
        throw err;
      }finally{ trackedTransactionPending = false; }
    }

      const parts = str.split(".");

      if(b.length > dec) throw new Error("USDC supports at most six decimal places.");
      const frac = b.padEnd(dec, "0");
      const amount = BigInt(a) * (10n**BigInt(dec)) + BigInt(frac || "0");
      if(amount > (1n << 256n) - 1n) throw new Error("USDC amount exceeds uint256.");
      return amount;
    }

    function namehash(name){
      const keccak = web3.utils.keccak256;
      let node = "0x" + "00".repeat(32);
      if(name){
        const labels = name.split(".");
        for(let i=labels.length-1;i>=0;i--){
          node = keccak(node + keccak(labels[i]).replace("0x",""));
        }
      }
      return node;
    }


    function formatTimestamp(ts){

      if(label.length < 8) return {label, ok:false, reason:'Minimum length is 8.'};
      if(label.length > 63) return {label, ok:false, reason:'Maximum length is 63.'};
      if(/\./.test(rawText)) return {label, ok:false, reason:'Dots are not allowed.'};
      if(/-/.test(rawText)) return {label, ok:false, reason:'Hyphens are not allowed.'};
      if(/\s/.test(rawText)) return {label, ok:false, reason:'Spaces are not allowed.'};
      if(!/^[a-z0-9]+$/.test(label)) return {label, ok:false, reason:'Use lowercase letters and digits only.'};
      return {label, ok:true, reason: rawText === label ? 'Label format is valid.' : 'Uppercase converted to lowercase for submission preview.'};
    }

    async function verifyUSDCDeployment(){
      const checkedWeb3 = web3;
      const checkedProvider = checkedWeb3?.currentProvider;
      const checkedManager = String(AGI_JOB_MANAGER || '');
      const checkedEpoch = APP_STATE.writeEpoch || 0;
      const checkId = (APP_STATE.deploymentCheckId || 0) + 1;
      APP_STATE.deploymentCheckId = checkId;
      const isCurrent = ()=> APP_STATE.deploymentCheckId === checkId && (APP_STATE.writeEpoch || 0) === checkedEpoch
        && web3 === checkedWeb3 && web3?.currentProvider === checkedProvider
        && String(AGI_JOB_MANAGER || '').toLowerCase() === checkedManager.toLowerCase();
      const staleCheck = ()=> Object.assign(new Error('Wallet, network or deployment changed during verification. Review the current deployment again.'), {code:'STALE_DEPLOYMENT_CHECK'});
      usdcDeploymentValidated = false;
      updateWriteGate();
      try {
        if(!checkedWeb3 || Number(await checkedWeb3.eth.getChainId()) !== 1) throw new Error('USDC console requires Ethereum mainnet.');
        if(!isCurrent()) throw staleCheck();
        if(!checkedWeb3.utils.isAddress(checkedManager) || /^0x0{40}$/i.test(checkedManager)) throw new Error('Enter a verified v0.9.6, v0.9.7 or v1.0.x USDC manager address.');
        const manager = new checkedWeb3.eth.Contract(AGIJobManagerABI, checkedManager);
        if(await checkedWeb3.eth.getCode(checkedManager) === '0x') throw new Error('No manager contract exists at this address.');
        const tokenAddress = String(await manager.methods.usdcToken().call());
        if(tokenAddress.toLowerCase() !== USDC_ADDRESS.toLowerCase()) throw new Error('Rejected: manager settlement token is not native Circle USDC.');
        const token = new checkedWeb3.eth.Contract(ERC20ABI, USDC_ADDRESS);
        if(Number(await token.methods.decimals().call()) !== 6) throw new Error('Rejected: USDC decimal verification failed.');
        const pauseClock = String(await manager.methods.settlementPausedSeconds().call());
        if(!/^\d+$/.test(pauseClock)) throw new Error('A v0.9.6-compatible manager with buyer protection is required.');
        const pendingOwner = String(await manager.methods.pendingOwner().call());
        if(!checkedWeb3.utils.isAddress(pendingOwner)) throw new Error('A v0.9.6-compatible manager with two-step ownership is required.');
        const wallet30 = String(await manager.methods.wallet30().call());
        const wallet10 = String(await manager.methods.wallet10().call());
        const invalid = ['0x'+'0'.repeat(40), checkedManager, USDC_ADDRESS].map(x=>x.toLowerCase());
        if([wallet30,wallet10].some(x=>!checkedWeb3.utils.isAddress(x)||invalid.includes(x.toLowerCase())) || wallet30.toLowerCase()===wallet10.toLowerCase()) throw new Error('Invalid USDC settlement wallets.');
        if(!isCurrent()) throw staleCheck();
        agiJobManager = manager;
        usdcToken = token;
        tokenDecimals = 6;
        usdcDeploymentValidated = true;
        if(el('settlementWallets')) el('settlementWallets').textContent = '30%: ' + wallet30 + ' · 10%: ' + wallet10;
        if(el('usdcDeploymentStatus')) el('usdcDeploymentStatus').textContent = 'USDC settlement check passed: ' + checkedManager;
      } catch(error) {
        if(!isCurrent()) throw staleCheck();
        usdcDeploymentValidated = false;
        usdcToken = null;
        if(el('usdcDeploymentStatus')) el('usdcDeploymentStatus').textContent = error.message + ' Transactions disabled.';
        throw error;
      } finally { if(isCurrent()) updateWriteGate(); }
    }

    function fmtRemaining(targetTs){
      const t = Number(targetTs||0);
      if(!t) return "—";
      const diff = t - Math.floor(Date.now()/1000);
      if(diff <= 0) return "ready / elapsed";
      const d = Math.floor(diff/86400);
      const h = Math.floor((diff%86400)/3600);
      const m = Math.floor((diff%3600)/60);
      if(d>0) return `${d}d ${h}h remaining`;
      if(h>0) return `${h}h ${m}m remaining`;
      return `${m}m remaining`;

          classifyJobStatus(job), ensLabelPreviewForJobId(job.id)
        ].join(" ").toLowerCase();
        if(!hay.includes(query)) return false;

      if(jobStatusFilter !== "all" && classifyJobStatus(job) !== jobStatusFilter) return false;
      if(jobRoleFilter === "employer" && String(job.employer).toLowerCase() !== String(userAccount||"").toLowerCase()) return false;

    function safeLink(uri){
      const u = String(uri||"").trim();
      if(!u) return "";
      const esc = u
        .replace(/&/g,"&")
        .replace(/</g,"<")
        .replace(/>/g,">")
        .replace(/\"/g,""")
        .replace(/'/g,"'");
      const lower = u.toLowerCase();
      if(lower.startsWith("https://") || lower.startsWith("http://")){
        return `<a href="${esc}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${esc}</a>`;
      }
      if(lower.startsWith("ipfs://")){
        const link = normalizeIpfsToHttp(u)
          .replace(/&/g,"&")
          .replace(/</g,"<")
          .replace(/>/g,">")
          .replace(/\"/g,""")
          .replace(/'/g,"'");
        return `<a href="${link}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${esc}</a>`;
      }
      return `<span class="muted">${esc}</span>`;
    }

    
    function compareBigIntLike(a, b){ return a === b ? 0 : (a > b ? 1 : -1); }
    function jobUrgencyBucket(job){
      const status = classifyJobStatus(job);
      const now = nowSec();
      if(status === 'completion'){
        const reviewWindow = getProtocolNumber('completionReviewPeriod');
        const endTs = Number(job.deadlines?.settlementAfter || 0);
        return [0, endTs ? Math.max(0, endTs - now) : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, -Number(job.id)];
      }
      if(status === 'assigned'){
        const expiryTs = Number(job.deadlines?.assignmentDeadline || 0);
        return [1, expiryTs ? Math.max(0, expiryTs - now) : Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, -Number(job.id)];
      }
      if(status === 'disputed') return [2, -(Number(job.disputedAt || 0)), -Number(job.id)];
      if(status === 'open') return [3, 0, -Number(job.id)];
      if(status === 'completed') return [4, -(Number(job.completionRequestedAt || 0)), -Number(job.id)];
      if(status === 'expired') return [5, -(Number(job.assignedAt || 0)), -Number(job.id)];
      return [9, 0, -Number(job.id)];
    }
    function compareJobs(a, b, mode){
      if(mode === 'oldest') return Number(a.id) - Number(b.id);
      if(mode === 'payout-desc') return compareBigIntLike(BigInt(b.payout), BigInt(a.payout)) || (Number(b.id) - Number(a.id));
      if(mode === 'payout-asc') return compareBigIntLike(BigInt(a.payout), BigInt(b.payout)) || (Number(b.id) - Number(a.id));
      if(mode === 'status'){
        const order = {open:0, assigned:1, completion:2, disputed:3, completed:4, expired:5};
        const sa = order[classifyJobStatus(a)] ?? 99;
        const sb = order[classifyJobStatus(b)] ?? 99;
        return sa - sb || (Number(b.id) - Number(a.id));
      }
      if(mode === 'urgency'){
        const ua = jobUrgencyBucket(a), ub = jobUrgencyBucket(b);
        for(let i=0;i<ua.length;i++){ if(ua[i] !== ub[i]) return ua[i] > ub[i] ? 1 : -1; }
        return 0;
      }
      return Number(b.id) - Number(a.id);
    }

    async function getTokenBalanceAndAllowance(options={}){
      const tokenContract = options.tokenContract || usdcToken;
      const spender = options.spender || AGI_JOB_MANAGER;
      const owner = options.owner || userAccount;
      if(!tokenContract || !owner || !spender) throw new Error('Token balance/allowance read requires token, owner, and spender.');
      const [balanceRaw, allowanceRaw] = await Promise.all([
        tokenContract.methods.balanceOf(owner).call(),
        tokenContract.methods.allowance(owner, spender).call()
      ]);
      return { balance: BigInt(balanceRaw), allowance: BigInt(allowanceRaw) };
    }

    async function ensureTokenApprovalExact(tokenContract, spender, required, fmtDecimals, options={}){
      const writeContext = activeReviewedContext || captureWriteContext();
      await assertLiveWriteContext(writeContext);
      const needed = BigInt(required || 0);
      const owner = options.owner || userAccount;
      const actionLabel = options.actionLabel || 'this action';
      const tokenLabel = options.tokenLabel || 'Token';
      const postActionLabel = options.postActionLabel || actionLabel;
      const explanation = options.explanation || 'Approval is required before this write action can proceed.';
      const formatAmount = (v)=> typeof fmtDecimals === 'number' ? formatUnitsWithDecimals(v, fmtDecimals) : formatUnitsToAmount(v);
      const tokenAddress = options.tokenAddress || tokenContract?._address || 'unknown';
      if(needed <= 0n) return { ok:true, needed, balance:0n, allowance:0n, postAllowance:0n, approvalTx:false, zeroResetUsed:false, tokenAddress, spender };
      const initial = await getTokenBalanceAndAllowance({ tokenContract, spender, owner });
      if(initial.balance < needed){
        setToast(`Insufficient ${tokenLabel} balance for ${actionLabel}. Need ${formatAmount(needed)} (${needed.toString()} raw).`, 'bad');
        return { ok:false, needed, ...initial, postAllowance:initial.allowance, approvalTx:false, zeroResetUsed:false, tokenAddress, spender };
      }
      if(initial.allowance >= needed) return { ok:true, needed, ...initial, postAllowance:initial.allowance, approvalTx:false, zeroResetUsed:false, tokenAddress, spender };

      const approvalMode = 'exact';
      const targetApproval = needed;
      const reviewOk = await requestActionConfirmation({
        title:'Token approval required',
        writeContext, allowDuringAction:true,
        body:`${actionLabel} needs token approval before ${spender} can spend ${tokenLabel}.`,
        facts:[
          {label:'Token', value: `${tokenLabel} (${tokenAddress})`},
          {label:'Spender', value: spender},
          {label:'Required amount', value: `${formatAmount(needed)} (${needed.toString()} raw)`},
          {label:'Current allowance', value: `${formatAmount(initial.allowance)} (${initial.allowance.toString()} raw)`},
          {label:'Approval mode', value: approvalMode},
          {label:'Post-approval action', value: postActionLabel}
        ],
        checks:[
          {state:'Prerequisite', badge:'warn', text: explanation},
          {state:'Exact approval', badge:'good', text:'Only the required USDC amount is approved. Failed or rejected requests stop here; no automatic retry or unlimited approval.'}
        ],
        method:`approve(${spender}, ${targetApproval.toString()})`,
        confirmLabel:'Approve token'
      });
      if(!reviewOk) return { ok:false, needed, ...initial, postAllowance:initial.allowance, approvalTx:false, zeroResetUsed:false, tokenAddress, spender };

      const zeroResetUsed = false;
      await assertLiveWriteContext(writeContext);
      setToast(`Waiting for token approval for ${actionLabel}…`, 'warn');
      await runTrackedTx(`Approve ${tokenLabel} for ${actionLabel}`, ()=>tokenContract.methods.approve(spender, String(targetApproval)), { writeContext, pendingDetail:`Submitting token approval for ${actionLabel}.`, successDetail:`Token approval confirmed for ${actionLabel}.` });
      const post = await getTokenBalanceAndAllowance({ tokenContract, spender, owner });
      if(post.allowance < needed){
        setToast(`Approval mined but allowance is still insufficient for ${actionLabel}. Needed ${formatAmount(needed)}, now ${formatAmount(post.allowance)}.`, 'bad');
        return { ok:false, needed, balance:post.balance, allowance:initial.allowance, postAllowance:post.allowance, approvalTx:true, zeroResetUsed, tokenAddress, spender };
      }
      return { ok:true, needed, balance:post.balance, allowance:initial.allowance, postAllowance:post.allowance, approvalTx:true, zeroResetUsed, tokenAddress, spender };
    }

    async function ensureApproval(required, options={}){
      await verifyUSDCDeployment();
      const managerTokenAddr = String(await agiJobManager.methods.usdcToken().call());
      if(!usdcToken || String(usdcToken.options?.address || usdcToken._address || '').toLowerCase() !== managerTokenAddr.toLowerCase()){
        usdcToken = new web3.eth.Contract(ERC20ABI, managerTokenAddr);
      }
      const result = await ensureTokenApprovalExact(usdcToken, AGI_JOB_MANAGER, required, tokenDecimals, {
        ...options,
        tokenLabel: '$USDC',
        tokenAddress: managerTokenAddr
      });
      if(result.ok && result.approvalTx) setToast(`Token approval confirmed for ${options.actionLabel || 'this action'}.`, 'ok');
      return result;
    }

    function renderValidationStatus(job){
      const reqA = Math.max(1, Number(el('reqApprovals')?.textContent || 0));
      const reqD = Math.max(1, Number(el('reqDisapprovals')?.textContent || 0));
      const quorum = Math.max(1, Number(el('voteQuorum')?.textContent || 0));
      const approvals = Number(job.approvals || 0);
      const disapprovals = Number(job.disapprovals || 0);
      const totalVotes = approvals + disapprovals;
      let note = 'Waiting for validator participation.';
      let cls = 'warn';
      if(job.completed){ note = 'Settled on-chain.'; cls = 'good'; }
      else if(job.disputed){ note = 'Job is currently in dispute.'; cls = 'bad'; }
      else if(!job.completionRequested){ note = 'Validation opens after a completion request.'; cls = ''; }
      else if(approvals >= reqA && approvals > disapprovals){ note = 'Approval threshold reached or close.'; cls = 'good'; }
      else if(disapprovals >= reqD && disapprovals >= approvals){ note = 'Disapproval threshold reached or close.'; cls = 'bad'; }
      else if(totalVotes >= quorum){ note = 'Quorum reached; outcome depends on majority / challenge window.'; cls = 'good'; }
      return `
        <div class="validationStack">
          <div class="validationMetric">
            <div class="validationMetricTop"><span>Approvals</span><span>${approvals}/${reqA}</span></div>
            <div class="validationMiniBar"><div class="validationMiniFill" style="width:${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, approvals / reqA * 100))}%"></div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="validationMetric">
            <div class="validationMetricTop"><span>Disapprovals</span><span>${disapprovals}/${reqD}</span></div>
            <div class="validationMiniBar"><div class="validationMiniFill" style="width:${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, disapprovals / reqD * 100))}%"></div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="validationMetric">
            <div class="validationMetricTop"><span>Total votes / quorum</span><span>${totalVotes}/${quorum}</span></div>
            <div class="validationMiniBar"><div class="validationMiniFill" style="width:${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, totalVotes / quorum * 100))}%"></div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="validationNote ${cls}">${note}</div>
        </div>`;
    }

        const details = el("jobDetails").value.trim();
        const payout = el("jobPayout").value.trim();
        const duration = el("jobDuration").value.trim();
        const specNorm = normalizeIpfsLikeUri(spec);
        if((!spec || !specNorm.valid) && lastUploadedMetadataURI) spec = lastUploadedMetadataURI;
        else if(specNorm.valid) spec = specNorm.canonical;
        if(!spec || !details || !payout || !duration) throw new Error("Fill in Job Spec URI, details, payout, and duration.");
        if(!isValidUriLoose(spec)) throw new Error("Job Spec URI must start with ipfs://, https://, http://, or ens://");
        if(el("jobSpecURI")) el("jobSpecURI").value = spec;
        const payoutUnits = parseAmountToUnits(payout);
        const durationInt = BigInt(duration);
        if(durationInt <= 0n || durationInt > 31536000n) throw new Error("Duration must be 1–31,536,000 seconds (up to 365 days), within the current on-chain limit.");
        if(payoutUnits <= 0n) throw new Error("Job cost must be greater than zero USDC.");

        if(durationInt > BigInt(postingTerms.jobDurationLimit)) throw new Error(`Duration exceeds the current limit of ${postingTerms.jobDurationLimit} seconds.`);

    async function verifySubdomain(kind, alpha=false){
      if(!requireConnected()) return;
      const isAgent = kind==="agent";
      const input = isAgent ? el("agentSub") : el("clubSub");
      const out = isAgent ? el("agentOut") : el("clubOut");
      const pill = isAgent ? el("agentPill") : el("clubPill");

      const suffix = isAgent ? (alpha ? SUFFIX.alphaAgent : SUFFIX.agent) : (alpha ? SUFFIX.alphaClub : SUFFIX.club);
      const clearRoleVerification = ()=>{
        verified[kind] = null;
        if(isAgent){
          verified.agentAlpha = false;
          const ab = el("agentAlphaBadge");
          if(ab) ab.style.display = "none";
        }else{
          verified.clubAlpha = false;
          const cb = el("clubAlphaBadge");
          if(cb) cb.style.display = "none";
          const vb = el("validatorBadge");
          if(vb) vb.style.display = "none";
        }
      };
      const sub = (input.value||"").trim();
      if(!/^[a-z0-9-]+$/.test(sub)){
        clearRoleVerification();
        out.textContent="Invalid format. Use lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens.";
        pill.className="pill bad";
        pill.textContent=(isAgent?"Agent":"Club")+" ENS: invalid";
        updateReadinessUI();
        return;
      }

      try{
        const full = `${sub}.${suffix}`;
        const tokenID = namehash(full);
        const managerWrapperAddr = await agiJobManager?.methods?.nameWrapper?.().call().catch(()=> '');
        const wrapperCheckDegraded = !managerWrapperAddr || isZeroAddress(managerWrapperAddr);
        const runtimeNameWrapper = wrapperCheckDegraded ? NAME_WRAPPER : managerWrapperAddr;
        const nw = new web3.eth.Contract(NameWrapperABI, runtimeNameWrapper);
        const owner = await nw.methods.ownerOf(tokenID).call();
        const acct = String(userAccount || '').toLowerCase();
        const ownerLc = String(owner || '').toLowerCase();
        const approved = await nw.methods.getApproved(tokenID).call().catch(()=>"0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000");
        const approvedLc = String(approved || '').toLowerCase();
        const approvedForAll = await nw.methods.isApprovedForAll(owner, userAccount).call().catch(()=>false);
        let resolverAddrMatch = false;
        try{
          const ensRegistryAddr = await agiJobManager.methods.ens().call();
          if(ensRegistryAddr && !isZeroAddress(ensRegistryAddr)){
            const ensRegistry = new web3.eth.Contract(ENSRegistryResolverABI, ensRegistryAddr);
            const nodeResolver = await ensRegistry.methods.resolver(tokenID).call().catch(()=>"0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000");
            resolverAddrMatch = !!nodeResolver && String(nodeResolver).toLowerCase() === acct;
          }
        }catch{}
        const isAuthorized = ownerLc === acct || approvedLc === acct || !!approvedForAll || resolverAddrMatch;

        if(isAuthorized){
          verified[kind] = sub;
          if(isAgent){
            verified.agentAlpha = !!alpha;
            const ab = el("agentAlphaBadge");
            if(ab) ab.style.display = alpha ? "inline-block" : "none";
          }else{
            verified.clubAlpha = !!alpha;
            const cb = el("clubAlphaBadge");
            if(cb) cb.style.display = alpha ? "inline-block" : "none";
            const vb = el("validatorBadge");
            if(vb) vb.style.display = "inline-block";
          }
          const mode = ownerLc === acct ? 'owner' : (approvedLc === acct ? 'token approval' : (approvedForAll ? 'operator approval' : 'resolver-address authorization'));
          out.textContent = `Verified (${mode}): ${full}`;
          pill.className = "pill ok";
          pill.textContent = (isAgent?"Agent":"Club") + (alpha ? " ENS: verified (alpha)" : " ENS: verified");
          await loadJobs();
          await updateDynamicInsights();
        }else{
          clearRoleVerification();
          out.textContent = `Not authorized for this wallet: ${full}`;
          pill.className = "pill bad";
          pill.textContent = (isAgent?"Agent":"Club") + " ENS: not verified";
        }
        updateReadinessUI();
      }catch(e){
        console.error(e);
        clearRoleVerification();
        out.textContent = `Verification error: ${e.message || String(e)}`;
        pill.className = "pill bad";
        pill.textContent = (isAgent?"Agent":"Club") + " ENS: error";
        updateReadinessUI();
      }
    }

function normalizeIpfsToHttp(uri){
      const u = String(uri||"").trim();
      if(u.startsWith("ipfs://")){
        return "https://ipfs.io/ipfs/" + u.slice("ipfs://".length).replace(/^ipfs\//,"");
      }
      return u;
    }
    function looksLikeBareCid(value){
      const v = String(value||"").trim();
      return /^(Qm[1-9A-HJ-NP-Za-km-z]{44}|bafy[a-z2-7]{20,}|bafk[a-z2-7]{20,})$/i.test(v);
    }
    function normalizeIpfsLikeUri(input){
      const raw = String(input||"").trim();
      if(!raw) return { raw:"", canonical:"", gateway:"", valid:false, kind:"empty", isCanonicalIpfs:false, uriBytes:0 };
      let canonical = raw;
      let kind = "other";
      let m;
      if(/^ipfs:\/\//i.test(raw)){
        canonical = "ipfs://" + raw.replace(/^ipfs:\/\//i,"").replace(/^ipfs\//i,"").replace(/^\/+/,"");
        kind = "ipfs";
      }else if((m = raw.match(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+\/ipfs\/(.+)$/i))){
        canonical = "ipfs://" + m[1].replace(/^ipfs\//i,"").replace(/^\/+/,"");
        kind = "gateway";
      }else if((m = raw.match(/^\/?ipfs\/(.+)$/i))){
        canonical = "ipfs://" + m[1].replace(/^\/+/,"");
        kind = "path";
      }else if(looksLikeBareCid(raw)){
        canonical = "ipfs://" + raw;
        kind = "cid";
      }else if(/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)){
        canonical = raw;
        kind = "http";
      }else if(/^ens:\/\//i.test(raw)){
        canonical = raw;
        kind = "ens";
      }
      const valid = isValidUriLoose(canonical);
      const gateway = canonical.startsWith("ipfs://") ? normalizeIpfsToHttp(canonical) : canonical;
      const uriBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(canonical).length;
      return { raw, canonical, gateway, valid, kind, isCanonicalIpfs: canonical.startsWith("ipfs://"), uriBytes };
    }

      }catch{

            normalized.isCanonicalIpfs ? 'canonical ipfs tokenURI' : 'valid tokenURI',
            imageNorm.isCanonicalIpfs ? 'canonical ipfs image' : (imageNorm.valid ? 'public image URI' : 'missing image URI')
          ]

        const sameImage = expectedImage.valid && imageNorm.valid ? imageNorm.canonical === expectedImage.canonical : null;
        checks.push({label:'Metadata JSON reachable', state:'Yes', cls:'good'});
        checks.push({label:'Metadata image field', state:imageNorm.valid ? 'Present and public' : 'Missing or invalid', cls:imageNorm.valid ? 'good' : 'bad'});
        if(expectedImageRaw.trim()) checks.push({label:'Matches expected final PNG', state:sameImage ? 'Yes' : (sameImage === false ? 'No' : 'Unable to compare'), cls:sameImage ? 'good' : (sameImage === false ? 'bad' : 'warn')});
        const elite = normalized.isCanonicalIpfs && imageNorm.valid;
        result.posture = elite ? 'Elite / NFT-display ready' : 'Valid but improve formatting';
        result.validatorNote = imageNorm.valid
          ? `Validators can review this completion by opening the metadata JSON and confirming that its <code>image</code> field resolves to the final PNG. No hidden off-chain context is required.`
          : `This metadata JSON does not expose a strong public <code>image</code> reference yet. Validators may struggle to confirm the final deliverable.`;
      }else if(fetchMode === 'direct-image'){
        result.preview = {
          name: `Direct image URI for job #${jobId}`,
          description: 'This URI appears to point directly to an image asset rather than metadata JSON. That can be useful for raw evidence, but it is not the elite pattern for NFT tokenURI display.',
          image: imageUri || normalized.canonical,
          badges: ['Direct image URI', normalized.isCanonicalIpfs ? 'canonical asset URI' : 'non-canonical asset URI', 'not metadata JSON']
        };
        result.jsonText = 'This URI appears to resolve directly to an image asset. For elite NFT display, submit metadata JSON instead.';
        checks.push({label:'Metadata JSON reachable', state:'No — direct image detected', cls:'warn'});

        if(expectedImageRaw.trim()){

        }

        result.validatorNote = 'Validators can still review the public image, but a metadata JSON Job Completion URI is stronger for downstream NFT rendering and archival clarity.';
      }else{

      }

    async function submitCompletionFromAssistant(){
      if(!requireConnected()) return;
      if(!mustBeReadyToWrite()) return;
      const assistant = completionAssistantState;
      const jobId = assistant.jobId;
      const writeContext = assistant.writeContext;
      if(jobId == null) throw new Error('Open an assigned job first.');
      const assertAssistantCurrent = ()=>{
        if(completionAssistantState !== assistant) throw new Error('Completion assistant changed. Open the intended job and review its submission again.');
        assertWriteContext(writeContext);
      };
      assertAssistantCurrent();
      const normalized = normalizeCompletionUriField(false);
      if(!normalized.valid) throw new Error('Enter a valid Job Completion URI. Bare CIDs can be normalized automatically.');
      const publication = await requestActionConfirmation({
        writeContext, publicContent:true, title:'Review public completion content',
        body:'The completion URI and referenced public files may be copied permanently. Review them before any metadata inspection or transaction.',
        facts:[{label:'Job',value:String(jobId)},{label:'Public completion URI',value:normalized.canonical}],
        method:'requestJobCompletion(' + jobId + ', ' + JSON.stringify(normalized.canonical) + ')',
        confirmLabel:'Review metadata and submit'
      });
      if(!publication) return;
      assertAssistantCurrent();
      const currentUri = normalizeCompletionUriField(false);
      if(!currentUri.valid || currentUri.canonical !== normalized.canonical) throw new Error('Completion URI changed. Review the new public content before inspection or submission.');
      let inspection = assistant.inspected;
      if(!inspection || inspection.normalized?.canonical !== normalized.canonical){ inspection = await inspectCompletionUri(true); }
      assertAssistantCurrent();
      if(normalized.uriBytes > 1024) throw new Error('The completion URI exceeds the contract limit of 1024 bytes.');
      const posture = inspection?.posture || '';
      if(/direct image/i.test(posture)){
        const ok = await requestActionConfirmation({writeContext,title:'Direct image completion URI detected', body:'This completion URI appears to point directly to an image rather than metadata JSON. That can weaken downstream NFT display and indexer compatibility.', checks:[{state:'Metadata posture', badge:'warn', text:'Continue only if you explicitly want a direct-image URI.'}], method:'requestJobCompletion(jobId, completionURI)', confirmLabel:'Continue with direct image'});
        if(!ok) return;
      }
      assertAssistantCurrent();
      if(/Invalid/i.test(posture)) throw new Error('The completion URI is not ready yet.');
      saveCompletionDraft(jobId);
      setToast('Submitting requestJobCompletion…', 'warn');
      await runTrackedTx(`Request completion for job #${jobId}`, ()=>agiJobManager.methods.requestJobCompletion(String(jobId), normalized.canonical), { writeContext, pendingDetail:`Submitting requestJobCompletion for job #${jobId}.`, successDetail:`Completion request for job #${jobId} confirmed.` });
      if(completionAssistantState === assistant) closeCompletionAssistant();
      await refreshAll();
    }

    function escapeHtml(v){
      return String(v==null?"":v).replace(/[&<>"\']/g, m => {
        if(m === '&') return '&';
        if(m === '<') return '<';
        if(m === '>') return '>';
        if(m === '"') return '"';
        return ''';
      });
    }

    function getProtocolBigInt(key, fallback=0n){

        return BigInt(String(v));
