    function simulateJobSettlement(job){
      const payout = BigInt(job.payout || 0);
      const approvals = Number(job.approvals || 0);
      const disapprovals = Number(job.disapprovals || 0);
      const totalVotes = approvals + disapprovals;
      if(!/^[0-9]+$/.test(String(job.agentPayoutPct)) || BigInt(job.agentPayoutPct) > 59n) throw new Error('Job payment split unavailable. Refresh before acting.');
      const agentPct = BigInt(job.agentPayoutPct);
      const validationPct = 60n - agentPct;
      const rewardPool = totalVotes === 0 ? 0n : payout * validationPct / 100n;
      const wallet30Amount = payout * 30n / 100n;
      const wallet10Amount = payout * 10n / 100n;
      const agentPayout = payout - rewardPool - wallet30Amount - wallet10Amount;
      const validatorBond = job.bonds?.validatorFixed === true ? BigInt(job.bonds.validatorAmount) : null;
      const slashText = el('validatorSlashBps')?.textContent?.trim();
      const slashBps = /^[0-9]+$/.test(slashText || '') && BigInt(slashText) <= 10000n ? BigInt(slashText) : null;
      const slashedPerIncorrect = validatorBond == null || slashBps == null ? null : validatorBond * slashBps / 10000n;
      const quorum = Number(el("voteQuorum")?.textContent || 0);
      const reqA = Number(el("reqApprovals")?.textContent || 0);
      const reqD = Number(el("reqDisapprovals")?.textContent || 0);
      const reviewEnded = !!job.deadlines?.settlementAfter && !job.deadlines.paused && nowSec() > job.deadlines.settlementAfter;
      let headline = "Pending review";
      let rationale = "The job is still moving through the protocol lifecycle.";
      if(job.completed) { headline = "Settled"; rationale = "The job already reached a terminal settlement path."; }
      else if(job.expired) { headline = "Expired"; rationale = "The job ended through expiry or an unanswered-dispute refund. Check its transaction timeline."; }
      else if(job.disputed) { headline = "Disputed"; rationale = "An independent moderator may resolve the dispute. Owner escalation and a neutral timeout refund have explicit on-chain deadlines."; }
      else if(!job.completionRequested) { headline = "Not in review yet"; rationale = "Finalization is not available before a completion request exists."; }
      else if(!job.deadlines) { headline = "Deadline unknown"; rationale = "Exact deadlines could not be read. Refresh with a healthy provider before acting."; }
      else if(job.deadlines.paused) { headline = "Review clock paused"; rationale = "Settlement is paused. The remaining review and dispute time is preserved."; }
      else if(!Number.isSafeInteger(quorum) || quorum < 1) { headline = "Review rules unavailable"; rationale = "The quorum could not be read. Refresh before choosing a settlement action."; }
      else if(reviewEnded && totalVotes===0) { headline = "Escalate unreviewed work"; rationale = "No votes: finalization opens a dispute without paying the agent. The buyer may instead explicitly accept satisfactory work."; }
      else if(reviewEnded && (totalVotes < quorum || approvals===disapprovals)) { headline = "Finalize now → dispute path"; rationale = "Under quorum or a tie forces the job into dispute after the review window."; }
      else if(reviewEnded && approvals>disapprovals) { headline = "Finalize now → agent-win path"; rationale = "Approvals exceed disapprovals after the review window and quorum is satisfied."; }
      else if(reviewEnded && disapprovals>approvals) { headline = "Finalize now → employer-win path"; rationale = "Disapprovals exceed approvals after the review window and quorum is satisfied."; }
      else if(approvals >= reqA && approvals > disapprovals) { headline = "Approval threshold reached"; rationale = "Payment must wait through the full review and approval challenge periods, unless the buyer explicitly accepts. The exact deadline is shown below."; }
      else if(disapprovals >= reqD) { headline = "Dispute threshold reached"; rationale = "Required disapprovals can move the job into dispute before ordinary finalization."; }
      return { payout, rewardPool, agentPayout, wallet30Amount, wallet10Amount, validatorBond, slashedPerIncorrect, approvals, disapprovals, totalVotes, headline, rationale, quorum, reqA, reqD, reviewEnded };
    }
    async function fetchJobTimeline(jobId){
      const names = ["JobCreated","JobApplied","JobCompletionRequested","JobValidated","JobDisapproved","JobDisputed","JobCompleted","JobExpired","JobAccepted","UnresolvedDisputeRefunded","JobApprovalThresholdReached","ValidatorCredentialUsed","NFTIssued","EnsHookAttempted"];
      const out = [];
      for(const name of names){
        try{
          const events = await agiJobManager.getPastEvents(name, {filter:{jobId:String(jobId)}, fromBlock:0, toBlock:"latest"});
          for(const ev of events){
            const bn = ev.blockNumber;
            let block = null;
            try{ block = await web3.eth.getBlock(bn); }catch{}
            out.push({name, bn, timestamp:block?.timestamp || 0, values:ev.returnValues || {}});
          }
        }catch{}
      }
      out.sort((a,b)=> (a.bn-b.bn) || (a.timestamp-b.timestamp));
      return out;
    }

    function parseAdminArg(type, raw, fieldName='arg'){
      const value = String(raw || '').trim();
      if(!value) throw new Error(`Missing required value for ${fieldName}.`);
      if(type.startsWith('uint')){
        if(!/^\d+$/.test(value)) throw new Error(`Invalid ${type} for ${fieldName}. Use a non-negative integer.`);
        return value;
      }
      if(type === 'bool'){
        if(/^(1|true|yes)$/i.test(value)) return true;
        if(/^(0|false|no)$/i.test(value)) return false;
        throw new Error(`Invalid bool for ${fieldName}. Use true/false.`);
      }
      if(type === 'address'){
        if(!web3?.utils?.isAddress?.(value)) throw new Error(`Invalid address for ${fieldName}.`);
        return value;
      }
      if(type === 'bytes32'){
        if(!/^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(value)) throw new Error(`Invalid bytes32 for ${fieldName}.`);
        return value;
      }
      if(type === 'bytes'){
        if(!/^0x[0-9a-fA-F]*$/.test(value) || (value.length % 2 !== 0)) throw new Error(`Invalid bytes for ${fieldName}. Must be 0x-prefixed hex.`);
        return value;
      }
      return value;
    }

    async function executeAdminControl(target, method, danger=false){
      if(!requireConnected() || !mustBeReadyToWrite()) return;
      const writeContext = captureWriteContext();
      const contract = target === 'ens' ? ensJobPages : agiJobManager;
      const account = String(userAccount || '').toLowerCase();
      const managerOwner = String(APP_STATE.admin?.managerOwner || '').toLowerCase();
      const ensOwner = String(APP_STATE.admin?.ensOwner || '').toLowerCase();
      const isManagerOwner = !!account && !!managerOwner && account === managerOwner;
      const isEnsOwner = !!account && !!ensOwner && account === ensOwner;
      const isModerator = APP_STATE.admin?.isModerator === true;
      const moderatorMethods = new Set(['resolveDisputeWithCode']);
      const isPendingOwner = !!account && account === String(APP_STATE.admin?.pendingOwner || '').toLowerCase();
      const authorized = target === 'ens' ? isEnsOwner : method === 'acceptOwnership' ? isPendingOwner : moderatorMethods.has(method) ? isModerator : isManagerOwner;
      const requiredRole = target === 'ens' ? 'ENSJobPages owner' : method === 'acceptOwnership' ? 'proposed new owner' : moderatorMethods.has(method) ? 'AGIJobManager moderator' : 'AGIJobManager owner';
      if(!authorized){
        setToast(`Not authorized for ${method}. Required role: ${requiredRole}.`, 'bad');
        return;
      }
      const args = await collectAdminArgs(target, method, danger);
      if(args === null) return;
      const publishesText = (ADMIN_METHOD_SCHEMAS[method] || []).some(field=>['string','bytes'].includes(field.type));
      assertWriteContext(writeContext);
      if(method === 'setJobDurationLimit' && (BigInt(args[0]) < 1n || BigInt(args[0]) > 31536000n)) throw new Error('Job duration limit must be 1–31,536,000 seconds (up to 365 days).');
      if(['addAGIType','disableAGIType'].includes(method)) {
        const reserves = await Promise.all(['lockedEscrow','lockedAgentBonds','lockedValidatorBonds','lockedDisputeBonds'].map(name=>contract.methods[name]().call()));
        if(reserves.some(value=>BigInt(value)!==0n)) throw new Error('NFT collection changes require all job escrow and bonds to be cleared. Changing the default affects future jobs only.');
      }
      if(method === 'setSettlementWallets') {
        const paused = await contract.methods.paused().call();
        const reserves = await Promise.all(['lockedEscrow','lockedAgentBonds','lockedValidatorBonds','lockedDisputeBonds'].map(name=>contract.methods[name]().call()));
        if(!paused || reserves.some(x=>BigInt(x)!==0n)) throw new Error('Pause intake and settle or refund all outstanding jobs and bonds before rotating wallets. Keep settlement enabled while draining jobs.');
        const invalid = ['0x'+'0'.repeat(40), AGI_JOB_MANAGER, USDC_ADDRESS].map(x=>x.toLowerCase());

  <script id="v33-session-modal-upgrade">
    (function(){
      const SESSION_KEY = 'agijm_v33_session';
      const ACCESS_FIELDS = ['agentSub','clubSub','mintAlphaLabel','termsAccepted'];
      function byId(id){ return document.getElementById(id); }
      function readSession(){ try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY)||'{}')||{}; }catch{ return {}; } }
      function writeSession(patch){
        const next = {...readSession(), ...patch, savedAt:Date.now()};
        delete next.termsAccepted;
        try{ localStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, JSON.stringify(next)); }catch{}
      }
      function showSessionRestore(msg){
        const note = byId('sessionRestoreNote');
        if(!note) return;
        note.innerHTML = `<b>Session restored.</b> ${msg}`;
        note.style.display = 'block';
        clearTimeout(showSessionRestore._timer);
        showSessionRestore._timer = setTimeout(()=>{ note.style.display='none'; }, 5200);
      }
      function persistAccessState({hintsOnly=false}={}){
        const state = {
          agentSub: String(byId('agentSub')?.value||'').trim(),
          clubSub: String(byId('clubSub')?.value||'').trim(),
          mintAlphaLabel: String(byId('mintAlphaLabel')?.value||'').trim(),
          agentAlphaPreferred: !!(typeof verified === 'object' && verified && verified.agentAlpha),
          clubAlphaPreferred: !!(typeof verified === 'object' && verified && verified.clubAlpha),
          accountHint: String(byId('walletStatus')?.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase(),
          chainHint: String(byId('chainStatus')?.textContent || '').trim()
        };
        // A late wallet refresh must not overwrite newer saved input from
        // another tab or a pending restore with stale DOM values.
        if(hintsOnly){ delete state.agentSub; delete state.clubSub; delete state.mintAlphaLabel; }
        writeSession(state);
      }
      function restoreAccessState(){
        const saved = readSession();
        let touched = false;
        if(byId('agentSub') && saved.agentSub){ byId('agentSub').value = saved.agentSub; touched = true; }
        if(byId('clubSub') && saved.clubSub){ byId('clubSub').value = saved.clubSub; touched = true; }
        if(byId('mintAlphaLabel') && saved.mintAlphaLabel){ byId('mintAlphaLabel').value = saved.mintAlphaLabel; touched = true; }
        resetTermsAcknowledgement();
        writeSession({});
        try{ if(typeof updateWriteGate === 'function') updateWriteGate(); if(typeof updateAlphaMintPreview === 'function') updateAlphaMintPreview(); }catch{}
        if(touched) showSessionRestore('Access inputs restored. Read and acknowledge the protocol notices again before signing.');
      }
      function invalidateVerification(reason='Verification must be refreshed for this wallet/network.'){
        try{
          if(typeof verified === 'object' && verified){
            verified.agent = null;
            verified.club = null;
            verified.agentAlpha = false;
            verified.clubAlpha = false;
          }
          const ap=byId('agentPill'); if(ap){ ap.className='pill warn'; ap.textContent='Agent ENS: re-verification required'; }
          const cp=byId('clubPill'); if(cp){ cp.className='pill warn'; cp.textContent='Club ENS: re-verification required'; }
          const vb=byId('validatorBadge'); if(vb) vb.style.display='none';
          if(byId('agentAlphaBadge')) byId('agentAlphaBadge').style.display='none';
          if(byId('clubAlphaBadge')) byId('clubAlphaBadge').style.display='none';
          if(byId('agentOut')) byId('agentOut').textContent = reason;
          if(byId('clubOut')) byId('clubOut').textContent = reason;
          if(typeof updateWriteGate === 'function') updateWriteGate();
        }catch{}
      }
      async function reverifySavedInputs(){
        const saved = readSession();
        const agentSub = String(byId('agentSub')?.value||saved.agentSub||'').trim();
        const clubSub = String(byId('clubSub')?.value||saved.clubSub||'').trim();
        const preferAgentAlpha = !!saved.agentAlphaPreferred;
        const preferClubAlpha = !!saved.clubAlphaPreferred;
        if(agentSub && typeof verifySubdomain === 'function'){
          if(preferAgentAlpha){
            await verifySubdomain('agent', true);
          }else{
            await verifySubdomain('agent', false);
          }
        }
        if(clubSub && typeof verifySubdomain === 'function'){
          if(preferClubAlpha){
            await verifySubdomain('club', true);
          }else{
            await verifySubdomain('club', false);
          }
        }
      }
      async function silentWalletRefresh(){
        if(!window.ethereum?.request) return;
        try{
          const accounts = await window.ethereum.request({method:'eth_accounts'});
          const account = accounts && accounts[0] ? String(accounts[0]) : '';
          if(!account){
            userAccount = null;
            APP_STATE.wallet.account = null;
            verified.agent = null;
            verified.club = null;
            verified.agentAlpha = false;
            verified.clubAlpha = false;
            hasAcceptedTerms = false;
            APP_STATE.wallet.termsAccepted = false;
            const tac = byId('termsAccepted');
            if(tac) tac.checked = false;
            if(byId('walletStatus')) byId('walletStatus').textContent = 'Not connected';
            if(byId('chainStatus')) byId('chainStatus').textContent = '—';
            const ap=byId('agentPill'); if(ap){ ap.className='pill'; ap.textContent='Agent ENS: not verified'; }
            const cp=byId('clubPill'); if(cp){ cp.className='pill'; cp.textContent='Club ENS: not verified'; }
            const vb=byId('validatorBadge'); if(vb) vb.style.display='none';
            const aab=byId('agentAlphaBadge'); if(aab) aab.style.display='none';
            const cab=byId('clubAlphaBadge'); if(cab) cab.style.display='none';
            if(byId('agentOut')) byId('agentOut').textContent = 'Wallet session not detected. Reconnect and re-verify.';
            if(byId('clubOut')) byId('clubOut').textContent = 'Wallet session not detected. Reconnect and re-verify.';
            if(typeof resetRuntimeState === 'function') resetRuntimeState('wallet disconnected');
            if(typeof updateWriteGate === 'function') updateWriteGate();
            persistAccessState({hintsOnly:true});
            return;
          }
          const saved = readSession();
          const accountHint = String(saved.accountHint || '').toLowerCase();
          const sameSession = !accountHint || accountHint.includes(account.slice(0,6).toLowerCase());

          const wasDisconnected = String(byId('walletStatus')?.textContent || '').toLowerCase().includes('not connected');
          const previousAccount = String(userAccount || '').toLowerCase();
          const accountChanged = !!previousAccount && previousAccount !== account.toLowerCase();
          userAccount = account;
          APP_STATE.wallet.account = account;
          if(byId('walletStatus')) byId('walletStatus').textContent = (typeof shortAddr === 'function') ? shortAddr(account) : account;

          try{
            if(!web3 && window.Web3) web3 = new Web3(window.ethereum);
            if(web3 && web3.eth && typeof web3.eth.getChainId === 'function'){
              const cid = Number(await web3.eth.getChainId());
              isMainnet = (cid === 1);
              APP_STATE.wallet.chainId = cid;
              APP_STATE.wallet.isMainnet = isMainnet;
              if(byId('chainStatus')) byId('chainStatus').textContent = `chainId ${cid}` + (isMainnet ? ' (Mainnet)' : ' (Not Mainnet)');
            }
          }catch{}

          if(typeof connectWallet === 'function' && wasDisconnected){
            await connectWallet();
          }else if(typeof refreshAll === 'function'){
            await refreshAll(true);
          }
          if(sameSession && !accountChanged){
            showSessionRestore('Wallet still detected. Re-validating membership…');
            await reverifySavedInputs();
          }else{
            hasAcceptedTerms = false;
            APP_STATE.wallet.termsAccepted = false;
            const tac = byId('termsAccepted');
            if(tac) tac.checked = false;
            invalidateVerification('Wallet or network changed. Re-verify agent/validator membership.');
          }
          persistAccessState({hintsOnly:true});
        }catch{}
      }
      function updateViewportVars(){
        const vv = window.visualViewport;
        const h = Math.round((vv?.height || window.innerHeight) * 100) / 100;
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--app-vh', `${h * 0.01}px`);
      }
      function syncModalState(){
        const anyOpen = !!document.querySelector('.modalBackdrop.open');
        document.body.classList.toggle('has-open-modal', anyOpen);
      }
      function moveVerifyNearTop(){
        const verify = byId('verifyEnsSection');
        const mission = byId('missionControlSection');
        if(!verify || !mission || !verify.parentElement) return;
        mission.parentElement.insertBefore(verify, mission);
      }
      function bindPersistence(){
        ACCESS_FIELDS.forEach(id=>{
          const node = byId(id);
          if(!node) return;
          const evt = id === 'termsAccepted' ? 'change' : 'input';
          node.addEventListener(evt, ()=>{
            if(id === 'termsAccepted'){ try{ hasAcceptedTerms = !!node.checked; }catch{} }
            persistAccessState();
          });
        });
      }
      window.addEventListener('load', ()=>{
        moveVerifyNearTop();
        restoreAccessState();
        bindPersistence();
        updateViewportVars();
        syncModalState();
        setTimeout(silentWalletRefresh, 280);
      });
      window.addEventListener('pageshow', ()=>{ restoreAccessState(); silentWalletRefresh(); });
      window.addEventListener('focus', ()=>silentWalletRefresh());
      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', ()=>{ if(document.visibilityState === 'visible') silentWalletRefresh(); });
      window.visualViewport?.addEventListener('resize', updateViewportVars);
      window.addEventListener('resize', updateViewportVars);
      new MutationObserver(syncModalState).observe(document.body, {subtree:true, attributes:true, attributeFilter:['class']});
    })();
  </script>
